Why I keep moving back to small towns

I grew up in a town where everyone knew your mum, and for years I thought that was the worst thing in the world. So I moved to Warsaw, then Berlin, then Warsaw again — and honestly it took me ten years to admit I missed it.

Big cities are great for some things, obviously. You can eat pierogi at 2am and nobody looks at you weird. But they're also kind of lonely in a way that's hard to explain, you know a thousand people and nobody notices if you disappear for a week.

In conclusion, I don't think one is better. I just think I'm a small town person who needed to leave to find that out, which is a bit annoying but fine.
